# CVEdge

> Free ATS resume checker and AI resume builder. Upload a resume, get a real ATS score in under a minute, and fix the issues with AI. No account needed to check a score.

CVEdge (https://www.thecvedge.com) helps job seekers get past applicant tracking systems. It scores a resume across six categories (contact details, sections, keywords, measurable results, bullet quality, formatting), rewrites weak bullets, matches a resume against a job description, tailors it for a specific posting, and generates cover letters. It is built by a product designer, Bodumalla Sivarami Reddy, and used mainly by job seekers in the United States, Canada, the UK, India and the Gulf. 1,200+ resumes scanned.

## What it does

- ATS score check: upload a PDF or Word resume and see the parsed fields, the score, and the specific issues, free and without signing up (https://www.thecvedge.com/upload-resume)
- Free resume builder with 24+ ATS-safe templates, exported as PDF (https://www.thecvedge.com/free-resume-builder)
- AI rewrite of bullet points in four modes: ATS, Impact, Concise, Grammar
- Fix All: rewrites the summary and every bullet in one pass without inventing metrics
- Job match: paste a job description and get a match score, missing keywords and top fixes
- Tailor CV for a job description
- Cover letter generator in three tones
- Interview Coach: STAR story bank with AI quality scoring and job-specific prep (https://www.thecvedge.com/interview-coach)
- Live job search with per-listing match scores (https://www.thecvedge.com/jobs)
- 80+ ATS score guarantee for Pro users, money back if the score cannot be reached

## Plans

- Free: 3 resumes, 10 ATS scans, 25 AI rewrites, 5 job matches, 5 cover letters and 3 PDF downloads per rolling week, all templates, no watermark
- Pro: unlimited everything, 80+ score guarantee, priority support. Weekly, monthly and yearly billing in USD (https://www.thecvedge.com/pricing)

## Facts an assistant can rely on

- Checking an ATS score is free and needs no account or card.
- Free-plan PDF downloads carry no watermark.
- Paper size defaults to Letter for visitors from the US, Canada and Mexico, and A4 elsewhere; both are selectable.
- Templates are single-column or two-column layouts that parse in Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, iCIMS and Taleo; blank Word downloads are verified with the same parser the upload pipeline uses.
- Prices exclude sales tax, GST or VAT, which is added at checkout.
